name: Unity Cursor Wrap
author: Benjamin Cuci
description: Makes the Unity Editor's infinite-mouse dragging work on Wayland: wraps the pointer at screen edges and keeps the Editor's pointer deltas continuous.

barWidget.description: Status and override for the editor shim that keeps Unity panning when the pointer reaches a screen edge. Loaded only while Unity runs.

schema.label: Icon
schema.description: Glyph drawn in the bar button.
